_comment: Same format as shuffle/awsConfigs/*.json, which scripts/remote_test.py also accepts unchanged. serverInstance runs the uncooperative database; each proxyInstances entry runs an OnionPIR server serving a contiguous chunk of the clients, and the last one streams the database and relays it down the chain (set onionServerInstance instead for a single server); clientInstance runs the C simulated clients (default: the database streamer's host). The onion* knobs are optional; onionConnections is per server.
